name: Ray-Ellipsoid Intersection
aliases: Ellipsoid Ray Intersection via Quadratic Equation
definition: Computes the intersection of a ray with an ellipsoid defined by rotation matrix R, translation t, and scale S. Returns whether an intersection exists and the intersection point in world space.
summary: Ray-Ellipsoid Intersection computes the intersection of a ray with a 3D ellipsoid using a closed-form quadratic solution, distinguishing itself by being computationally cheaper than iterative root-finding methods.
